new_source_audits.note: Evans 1931 Andaman and Nicobar butterfly list reports P. memnon agenor as stragglers on Andamans; neither contemporary native-host absence nor reproductive colonization is independently resolved.
Jan 6 2010 Boone County Missouri listing of P. communis; no larval survival or local breeding cohort.
Minnesota DNR 2014 comparison names communis as another locally occurring species, but not a source date-specific sighting or voucher.
BAMONA observation date 2017-10-01, verification date 2021-11-30; original event earlier than cutoff, source confirmation later. No breeding claim and GBIF provenance independence unverified.

interpretive_boundary: An old occurrence can represent a straggler rather than a breeding population. This deliberately selected audit does not estimate false-detection rates, regional colonization times, host-following lags or globally representative biological effects. Source independence from GBIF samples has not been established.
